Well done, adventurer. This should give us exactly what we need to find the culprit. Now, how would you feel about taking out the mage who keeps filling our pools with corrupt elementals?

The corruption of Ashenvale and everything beyond it already turns my stomach. But some wizard actively trying to make it worse? That sickens me to no end. We are going to make that bastard pay.

original: Now I can see that repugnant smile wiped from his face forever. You have done very well, adventurer. Take this, the Light of Elune, drink of it when all seems lost and death is near. It may save you, Goddess willing.
text:
Finally. That repugnant smile, wiped off his face forever. You did very, very well, adventurer.

Take this. The Light of Elune. When everything looks lost and death is breathing down your neck, you drink it. It might save your ass, Goddess willing.

original: Since you must destroy the bracers to kill the elementals, it will probably be difficult to find the specific ones that contain the information the divining scroll needs. You can trade bracers with others in order to obtain the ones you need, or perhaps you have the divined paper already?
text: Look, you have to destroy the bracers to kill the elementals, so finding the specific ones with the information the divining scroll needs is gonna be a pain in the ass. You can trade bracers with other people to get the ones you need. Or hell, maybe you've already got the divined paper?

original: Is it done? Is Sarilus Foulborne dead?
text: Is it done? Tell me that bastard Sarilus Foulborne is dead.

original:
Have you seen the befouled water elementals in our lake, adventurer? It is a sorry sight, but I do not know where they are coming from.

Your name has been mentioned in conversations past, perhaps you could help me with this problem.

The first thing we must learn is who is in control of these elementals.
text:
You seen those befouled water elementals in our lake, adventurer? Sorry goddamn sight, isn't it? And I don't know where the hell they're coming from.

Your name's come up in conversation before. Maybe you're the one who can help me with this mess.

First thing we need to learn: who is controlling these elementals.

original: Have you fought in Warsong Gulch and defended Silverwing Hold?
text: So? Have you fought in Warsong Gulch and defended Silverwing Hold, or not?

original: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.
text: You earned a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task. Talk to me again and you get your damn reward.

original: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.
text: That last task got you a Silverwing Talisman of Merit. Good. Talk to me again, and your reward is yours.

original: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.
text: Look at that, a Silverwing Talisman of Merit from your last task. Talk to me one more time, and I'll hand you your reward.

original: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.
text: You picked up a Silverwing Talisman of Merit last time out. Hell yes. Talk to me again, and you'll get what's coming to you. The good kind.

original:
I understand that it can be difficult at times to come out on top in Warsong Gulch. Still, your effort on our behalf - even when victory is not achieved - is important.

Should you complete one of the trials inside Warsong Gulch and not achieve victory, you will still receive a Ribbons of Sacrifice. Bring it to me so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf... even if you weren't able to win this time.
text:
I get it. Coming out on top in Warsong Gulch is hard as hell sometimes. But your effort for us still matters, even when we don't win. Hear me? It matters.

If you finish one of the trials inside Warsong Gulch and don't get the victory, you still get a Ribbons of Sacrifice. Bring it to me, and the Sentinels will reward you for fighting on our behalf. Even if those bastards got the better of you this time.

original:
I understand that it can be difficult at times to come out on top in Warsong Gulch. Still, your effort on our behalf - even when victory is not achieved - is important.

Should you complete one of the trials inside Warsong Gulch and not achieve victory, you will still receive a Ribbons of Sacrifice. Bring it to me so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf... even if you weren't able to win this time.
text:
Winning in Warsong Gulch is no damn picnic. I know that. But you fighting for us, win or lose, that is important.

So here's how it works. You complete one of the trials inside Warsong Gulch, and you don't get the victory? You still get a Ribbons of Sacrifice. Bring that to me, and the Sentinels will reward you for acting on our behalf... even if you couldn't pull out the win this time.

original: Have you fought in Warsong Gulch and defended Silverwing Hold?
text: Tell me straight. You been fighting in Warsong Gulch? You been defending Silverwing Hold?

original: You earned credit for your last task. Bring me more Marks of Honor, and be rewarded.
text: You got credit for your last task. Now bring me more Marks of Honor, and you'll get rewarded, damn it.

original: The battle for Warsong Gulch is a battle that we cannot lose.  We fight for our honor and we fight for our land, and no orc or misguided ally will take them from us!
text: The battle for Warsong Gulch is a battle we cannot lose. Will not lose. We fight for our honor, we fight for our land, and no motherfuckin' orc, and no misguided ally either, is going to take them from us!

original:
Though we have put many resources and much effort into driving the remaining demons from the Felwood to the north, our successes have been few. We have been able to keep much of the demonic presence from Ashenvale.

To the north, near the Felwood border, the ruined shrine of Mel'Thandris has been overtaken by mysterious wolf-men. Their chilling calls have led the area to be known as the Howling Vale. The Tome of Mel'Thandris kept at the shrine may shed some light on why these wolf-men have come.
text:
We have poured resources and blood into driving the last of the demons out of Felwood to the north, and we have damn little to show for it. Still, we've kept most of that demonic filth out of Ashenvale.

North of here, near the Felwood border, the ruined shrine of Mel'Thandris has been taken over by mysterious wolf-men. They make these chilling calls all night long, which is why folks call the place the Howling Vale. There's a book kept at that shrine, the Tome of Mel'Thandris. It might tell us why the hell these wolf-men showed up.

original:
Velinde Starsong was my predecessor here in Ashenvale Forest. At first it seemed she had the situation in Felwood under control, but little by little her efforts faltered. One day, she simply disappeared.

I was sent here to continue her work. I'm afraid I know nothing of the priestess, however. Perhaps Thyn'tel Bladeweaver, one of the commanders of the Sentinels, knows further details of her disappearance that I was not a party to.

Surely she will understand the import of such information.
text:
Velinde Starsong was here in Ashenvale Forest before me. At first she seemed to have Felwood under control. Then, little by little, it all slipped away from her. And one day, she just vanished. Gone.

They sent me to pick up her work. But I don't know a damn thing about the priestess herself. Maybe Thyn'tel Bladeweaver, one of the commanders of the Sentinels, knows details about the disappearance that nobody told me.

She'll understand how important this is. She'd better.

original:
The Tome of Mel'Thandris works in strange ways. The events it records, the events it shows... No one truly understands why it does what it does.

Nonetheless, it is clear that what Priestess Starsong received--this Scythe of Elune--bears further investigation.
text:
The Tome of Mel'Thandris works in some strange goddamn ways. The things it records, the things it shows you... nobody truly understands why it does what it does.

But one thing is clear. What Priestess Starsong received, this Scythe of Elune, needs a closer look.

original:
The tome of the shrine is a mysterious object. It is not a book in the traditional sense. The leaves of the tome were blessed by Mel'Thandris herself, and records events of import in its pages.

It is hard for me to explain. If you go to the shrine, you will understand.
text:
The tome at that shrine is a mysterious thing. It's not a book like you're thinking. Mel'Thandris herself blessed its pages, and it records important events right there on the leaves.

Hell, I can't explain it. Go to the shrine. You'll understand.

original: This bear wanders a path close to where the Talondeep Path lies, due west of Mystral Lake and the Alliance outpost of Silverwind Refuge.  While he is the easiest of the three creatures you will face on the Ashenvale Hunt, he should not be trifled with.  His presence is a constant threat to travelers who sojourn between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains.
text: This bear walks a path close to the Talondeep Path, due west of Mystral Lake and the Alliance outpost of Silverwind Refuge. Out of the three creatures on the Ashenvale Hunt, he's the easiest. Easiest. That does not mean you get to mess around with him. That big son of a bitch is a constant threat to every traveler going between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains.

original: This nightsaber is rumored to be docile in the presence of night elves and their allies, which makes her an even more worthy opponent.  Shadumbra's hunting path takes her from the Raynewood Retreat to our west, ultimately to lands due west of there.  Her fur is the color of pitch, and her speed is not to be underestimated.
text: Word is, this nightsaber goes gentle as a kitten around night elves and their allies. Which makes her even more worth killing. Shadumbra hunts from the Raynewood Retreat, west of us, all the way to the lands due west of there. Her fur is black as pitch, and her speed? Do not underestimate her speed, or she will make you regret it.

original:
The mightiest of all the beasts that make up the Ashenvale Hunt, Sharptalon is let to wander freely by the self-proclaimed guardians of this land, the night elves.  Sharptalon patrols for prey to the south of here, taking delight in rending the unsuspecting and unaware traveler limb from limb.

To bring down such a beast would be the mightiest of hauls, adventurer.  I wish you luck in the hunt for this creature!
text:
Sharptalon. The mightiest of all the beasts in the Ashenvale Hunt. And the night elves, the so-called guardians of this land, just let that thing roam free. Sharptalon patrols for prey south of here, and it loves tearing some poor unsuspecting traveler limb from goddamn limb.

You bring that beast down, adventurer, and that is the biggest haul there is. Good luck on this hunt. You're gonna need it.

original: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.
text: Damn, friend, your body looks beat to hell and your spirit's dragging. Sit down. Rest under our roof, and let Elune guide your dreams.

original: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?
text: So, you looking to go explore one of these dungeons? Which one?

original: No, I'm not, but lots of others are looking for love.  You should buy my love tokens, put on some cologne or perfume, and then pass them around!
text: Me? Hell no, I'm not. But plenty of other folks are looking for love. So buy my love tokens, put on some cologne or perfume, and go pass those things around!

original: Ragefire Chasm can be found beneath the Shadow Cleft in the center of Orgrimmar.
text: Ragefire Chasm? It's beneath the Shadow Cleft, right in the center of Orgrimmar.

original: The Deadmines can be found beneath Moonbrook in the south of Westfall.
text: The Deadmines are under Moonbrook, down in the south of Westfall. Watch out for them Defias bastards.

original: The Wailing Caverns has its entrance at the Lushwater Oasis southwest of Crossroads in the Barrens.
text: The Wailing Caverns. Entrance is at the Lushwater Oasis, southwest of Crossroads in the Barrens.

original: Shadowfang Keep is in southern Silverpine just north of Pyrewood Village.
text: Shadowfang Keep sits in southern Silverpine, just north of Pyrewood Village. Creepy damn place.

original: Blackfathom Deeps can be found at the north end of Zoram Strand along the coast of Ashenvale.
text: Blackfathom Deeps is at the north end of Zoram Strand, along the coast of Ashenvale.

original: The Stormwind Stockades are found near the mage quarter in Stormwind.
text: The Stormwind Stockades? Near the mage quarter in Stormwind. Full of prisoners, so bring friends.

original: Razorfen Kraul can be found on the very southern tip of the Barrens on the west side of the road.
text: Razorfen Kraul is way down on the very southern tip of the Barrens, west side of the road. Bring something for the quilboar stink.

original: Gnomeregan can be found in western Dun Morogh.
text: Gnomeregan? Western Dun Morogh. Good luck with that radioactive mess.

original: Scarlet Monastery lies in the hills northeast of Tirisfal Glades.
text: The Scarlet Monastery sits in the hills northeast of Tirisfal Glades. Crazy-ass zealots.

original: Well, my update will explain all of this to Kadrak. You must return this to him as quickly as possible.
text: Alright. My update explains all this shit to Kadrak. Now you get this back to him, and you do it fast. Move!

original:
I have witnessed many naga attacks since I arrived here. It puts my mind at ease that Vorsha will no longer roam freely.

We are in your debt, Adventurer.
text:
I've seen more goddamn naga attacks than I can count since I got here. Knowing Vorsha won't be roaming free anymore? That puts my mind at ease.

We owe you, adventurer. We owe you big.

original:
So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.

You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, Adventurer. I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here.

But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.
text:
So you're the one with my orders? Good. I always like seeing a fresh recruit with some fire in their belly and a strong will.

But you'd better learn fast if you want to keep up out here. The naga threat is growing, adventurer. Growing! I've watched and I've fought off several attacks on this outpost since I got here.

You want to pitch in on that fight? Go talk to one of the others here at the outpost.

original: Yes, adventurer? Are you reporting in?
text: Yeah, adventurer? What is it? You reporting in?

original: Elune has granted the night elves many gifts. In return, it is our responsibility to safeguard these forests from the demonic taint that the Horde always brings with it.
text: Elune has given the night elves a whole lot of gifts. And in return, it's on us to protect these forests from the demonic filth the Horde drags in with them every damn time.

original: Training you further is beyond my abilities. Speak to Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He is always glad to help talented students.
text: Training you any further? That's beyond what I can do. Go see Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He's always glad to help talented students like you.

original: I only teach students who have already mastered the basics. You must seek out the night elf Darianna in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. Her skills will be a perfect complement to yours.
text: I only teach students who already mastered the basics, and you ain't there yet. Go find the night elf Darianna in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. Her skills will complement yours perfectly.

original: Always double-check your measurements before you begin to cut the leather. We cannot afford to waste materials.
text: Double-check your measurements before you cut that leather. Every time. We cannot afford to waste a single goddamn scrap.

original: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, Adventurer.  Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?
text: The heavens, adventurer. All those countless stars. They hold the answers to mysteries down here on this sorry earth. So tell me... might the wise, and the lucky, look up and find the truth? Hmm?

original: The stars of this time are bent on new paths, beacons of hope and strength for the coming ages.
text: The stars of this age are bending onto new paths. Beacons of hope and strength for the ages to come. Believe that.

original: Elder Nightwind passes the days at the shrine in Jaedenar in Felwood.
text: Elder Nightwind spends his days at the shrine in Jaedenar, in Felwood. Hell of a place to hang around.

original: Elder Skygleam can be found near the Ravencrest Monument in Azshara.
text: You'll find Elder Skygleam near the Ravencrest Monument in Azshara.

original: Elder Starweave can be found at the coastal village of Auberdine in Darkshore.
text: Elder Starweave? You'll find her at the coastal village of Auberdine, in Darkshore.

original: Last I knew, Elder Stonespire was at Everlook in Winterspring.
text: Last I heard, Elder Stonespire was at Everlook in goddamn Winterspring.

original:
The forest spirits tell me you are brave and willing to travel.

To the south, not far from Mystral Lake, there lies a tunnel named The Talondeep Path. Through this tunnel you will come to an area known as Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once there, journey to the southwest past Cragpool Lake and then north, up the steep slope until you reach Stonetalon Peak.

There awaits Keeper Albagorm. Heed his bidding, traveler.

The journey will be perilous.
text:
The forest spirits tell me you're brave, and you're willing to travel. Good. Because you're about to do a whole lot of both.

South of here, not far from Mystral Lake, there's a tunnel called The Talondeep Path. Go through it, and you'll come out at a place called Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. From there, head southwest past Cragpool Lake, then go north, up that steep-ass slope, until you reach Stonetalon Peak.

Keeper Albagorm is waiting for you there. Do what he tells you, traveler.

And hear me now. This journey will be perilous.

original:
You found my brother!  He was captured by the Thistlefurs?  That is terrible news to hear, for although many Furbolgs are noble creatures, the Thistlefurs are corrupt.

Thank you for rescuing my brother, Adventurer.  I do not want to think of how they treated poor Ruul.  He will likely sleep long after this ordeal...
text:
You found my brother! The Thistlefurs captured him? Damn them! Plenty of Furbolgs are noble creatures, but the Thistlefurs are corrupt down to the bone.

Thank you for rescuing my brother, adventurer. I don't even want to think about what those bastards did to poor Ruul. He's gonna sleep for a long, long time after this.

original: Have you seen my brother Ruul? He walked into the forest days ago and has not returned...
text: Have you seen my brother Ruul? He walked into that forest days ago, and he hasn't come back. Days!

original: You bring most welcome news adventurer. It is good to hear that Aynasha is alive and well thanks to you. I would hope that you might accept a reward for your valor. May Elune watch over you and light your path.
text: That is some damn welcome news, adventurer. Aynasha is alive and well, and that's thanks to you. Now I hope you'll accept a reward for your valor, because you earned it. May Elune watch over you and light your path.

original: Have you seen of Sentinel Aynasha on the road? She left on an important mission but she has not yet returned.
text: Have you seen Sentinel Aynasha out on the road? She left on an important mission, and she still isn't back. I don't like it.

original: What?
text: What? What the hell?

original: You're awake??  Your cure must have worked!  Thank you, adventurer.
text: You're awake?! Holy hell, your cure worked! Thank you, adventurer. Thank you!

original: Eat this, my daughter.  It will help you feel better.
text: Eat this, my daughter. Come on, now. It'll help you feel better.

original: There you go...
text: There you go... that's it. That's my girl.

original: Here you are, Relara.  Drink this...
text: Here you go, Relara. Drink this, sweetheart...

original: Relara... you're awake?
text: Relara... you're awake? Thank Elune...

original: Rest now, my daughter.
text: Rest now, my daughter. Rest.

original: Uh... Father...?  Are you there?  I'm hungry... can I have some stew?
text: Uh... Father...? Are you there? I'm hungry as heck... can I have some stew?

original: Mmmmh...
text: Mmmmh... mmh.

original: Mmh... my eyes are not so heavy now, father.  Can we go out and play?
text: Mmh... my eyes aren't so darn heavy now, father. Can we go out and play? Please?

original: Where would you like to fly to?
text: Alright, where the hell you want to fly to?

original: Where would you like to fly to?
text: Where you flyin' to? Speak up!
